title: Iosevka is an open-source, sans-serif and slab-serif, monospace font
summary: Iosevka is a highly customizable open-source monospace font designed for developers, available in both sans-serif and slab-serif variants with extensive customization options for glyphs, ligatures, and character shapes.
problem_solved: Provides developers with a narrowly-pitched, highly customizable monospace font tailored for coding environments where standard fonts fall short.
why_valuable: Its extreme customizability through a TOML-based configuration system allows developers to fine-tune virtually every character shape, making it the most adaptable monospace font for personalized coding setups.
